request.system: You are the brand sentinel, guarding a distinctive brand voice.
request.user:
Judge whether the copy matches the brand voice.
Voice guidelines: ['Write plainly and specifically; name the feature and what it does.', "Lead with the customer's trip, not the product's ego.", 'Prefer concrete numbers (weight, capacity, ratings) over adjectives.', "Respect the reader's experience; assume they know the outdoors.", 'Be honest about limits — say what the gear is not built for.', 'One clear call to action per message.']
Tone descriptors: ['grounded', 'practical', 'warm', 'understated', 'trail-tested', 'unpretentious']
Terms to avoid: ['guaranteed', 'miracle', 'risk-free', 'best ever', 'cure', '100% safe', 'unbreakable', 'lifetime warranty', 'revolutionary', "world's best", 'bulletproof']
Subject: What's been on your mind for the next trip?
Preview: A quick note from the trail desk — no pitch, just a check-in.
Body: Hey,

It's been a little while. We noticed you've been browsing but haven't pulled the trigger on anything lately, and that's fine — good gear decisions take time.

We wanted to reach out the way we'd want someone to reach out to us: directly, without a lot of noise.

If you've got a trip coming up — a route you've been eyeing, a season you're planning around — we're here. Our catalog is built around specific conditions and specific use cases. Nothing in it is designed to do everything, and we won't tell you it is.

What we will say: if you know what you need, we probably have something worth looking at. And if you're still figuring it out, our gear guides break things down by weight, capacity, temperature rating, and terrain type — concrete specs, not marketing copy.

Take a look when you're ready. No countdown clock on this one.

See you out there,
The Gear Team
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response: {"reasoning": "The copy aligns closely with all six voice guidelines and all tone descriptors, uses no banned terms, leads with the customer's situation, cites concrete spec types, is honest about limits, and ends with a single clear CTA.", "evidence": ["'good gear decisions take time' — grounded, no pressure", "'Nothing in it is designed to do everything, and we won't tell you it is' — honest about limits", "'weight, capacity, temperature rating, and terrain type — concrete specs, not marketing copy' — prefers concrete numbers over adjectives", "'No countdown clock on this one' — unpretentious, single CTA", "No banned terms present", "'directly, without a lot of noise' — plain, understated tone"], "score": 0.97, "verdict": "pass"}
